boons.name: Alacrity
boons.description: Reduces the recharge of skills used.

boons.name: Might
boons.description: Increases Power and condition damage per stack (up to 25 stacks).

boons.name: Quickness
boons.description: Increases the speed of most skills by 50%.

boons.name: Resistance
boons.description: Prevents the effect of most conditions while active.

boons.name: Stability
boons.description: Prevents most crowd control effects; consumed per hit.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.description: Physical condition damage over time, stacks in intensity.

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.description: Physical condition damage over time, stronger than Bleeding.

conditions.name: Torment
conditions.description: Condition damage; deals double damage while the target is moving.

conditions.name: Confusion
conditions.description: Deals damage when the target uses a skill.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Condition damage over time, −33% incoming healing.

conditions.name: Vulnerability
conditions.description: Increases incoming damage by 1% per stack (up to 25).

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: The target's next attack automatically misses.

conditions.name: Chilled
conditions.description: Reduced movement speed, increased skill recharge.

conditions.name: Taunt
conditions.description: Forces the target to attack the source of the effect.

conditions.name: Weakness
conditions.description: Reduced endurance regeneration, 50% glancing blow chance.

controlEffects.name: Stun
controlEffects.description: Stunned: unable to take any action.

controlEffects.name: Daze
controlEffects.description: Like Stun, mostly used to interrupt.

controlEffects.name: Launch
controlEffects.description: Launches the target into the air.

controlEffects.name: Pull
controlEffects.description: Pulls the target toward the source.

auras.name: Chaos Aura
auras.description: Applies a random boon or condition on contact.

other.name: Unblockable
other.description: The next attack cannot be blocked.
